svg.aria-label: Two rows of the same journey, log in, get token, call /me, 200 with the right user, both passing. Under the first, hidden from the test, one Django app and Postgres. Under the second, an auth service, a token service, a profile API and a new database. The test only touches the journey, so it survives.
svg.text: what a blackbox test can see vs what it can't
the test only touches the teal row, so it survives the rewrite underneath
